name: VimFinder v0.1.18
body:
## Download
**Download `VimFinder-0.1.18.zip` below** (under Assets), not the "Source code" ZIPs.

It holds both addons you need, already named right:
- `VimFinder` 0.1.18
- `VimWowSettings` 0.1.5

## Install
1. Unzip it into `Interface/AddOns/`.
2. At character select, under AddOns, tick **VimFinder** and **VimWowSettings**.
3. In game, press **Alt+Space**.

No DLL needed. The full guide is in the [README](https://octowow.st/git/Lupo/VimFinder#readme).

SHA256: `a88cfb367f96c3fb8a452da84e282564f715ad57d6e9c41930a612211854cab4`

In the forum and Discord posts, point the download at this asset instead of the two source ZIPs. Once it's uploaded, its link will be https://octowow.st/git/Lupo/VimFinder/releases/download/v0.1.18/VimFinder-0.1.18.zip. Then the install steps lose the rename step and become: download one ZIP, unzip it into Interface/AddOns/.
